searchText: I see it *is* a valid RLP string when encoding a non-scalar value (e.g. the byte 0x00). So the valid encoding is dependent on what the target “type” is. You are not talking about RLP but rather the unnamed Ethereum encoding scheme that sits above RLP. RLP can *only* encode byte arrays and lists (recursively). The unnamed encoding scheme Ethereum uses to turn everything into a byte arrays is the thing that has these rules about how to convert each data type into a byte arrays. And that unnamed encoding scheme is definitely type dependent, and in fact cannot be used without knowing the expected shape of the data. The geth team are they part of the EF? Yes who can i contact from there? Me 🙂 dming you
